text: maya-design: Quick check on the retention modal draft: region picker, retention dropdown, and an encryption indicator. Need wording that doesn't imply we hold customer keys + a11y for the badge. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def (screenshots). leo-pm: Decision needed: show org default region at top with tiny tag 'Org default' or show last user selection? I lean org default first. oliver-eng: Org default first is fine. We'll persist user overrides as a profile setting and show '(saved)' next to them. Avoid auto-switching on browser locale. sam-copy: Microcopy options: 1) "Retention period — 45 days (storage region: eu-central-1)" 2) "Data retained for 45 days. Storage region: eu-central-1." 3) "Retention: 45 days — stored in eu-central-1" I prefer option 1 for scan-ability. jo-a11y: A11y notes: encryption badge needs to be keyboard-focusable and announced. Don't use role=img. Use tabindex=0 and aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen description. Also include the selected region in the region picker's accessible name (e.g., 'Storage region, selected: eu-central-1'). tia-legal: Wording: do not use 'store' for keys. Use 'managed by your KMS' or 'under your KMS policy'. Also avoid showing ARNs or key IDs in tooltips. maya-design: For visual fallback when no org region: show small muted text 'Fallback: Global' under the picker. Make sure contrast passes. oliver-eng: CSV export currently outputs region_id and policy_id. We'll map to human headers: 'Storage region' and 'Retention policy'. For encryption column use 'Encryption' with values 'Platform-managed' or 'Customer-managed (KMS region: eu-central-1)'. sam-copy: For the on-screen badge keep short: 'Customer-managed' / 'Platform-managed'. Tooltip: 'Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: eu-central-1).' Tia ok with that? tia-legal: That phrasing is OK. Replace 'key' with 'encryption key' in tooltip. No keys or ARNs. jo-a11y: Implementation snippet suggestion: ``` Customer-managed Encryption type Customer-managed encryption key, managed by your KMS, region: eu-central-1 ``` Ensure focus ring visible and contrast for sr-only text is sufficient for high-contrast modes. leo-pm: Small UX ask: show 'Default: Organization setting' next to the org-default tag so users aren't surprised. If fallback to Global, show 'Fallback: Global' in muted text. maya-design: I'll update the figma with sam's preferred copy, add the sr-only nodes to the prototype, and label the CSV header change in the spec. Will ping team when ready for quick pass. deploy-bot: Staging build 2026-03-23T09:40:12 deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention (a11y snapshot attached). oliver-eng: I'll add unit tests that assert CSV header mapping and that region appears human-readable, not IDs. Tagging @jo-a11y for SR QA when staging is up. sam-copy: Can someone QA the copy strings in the code after the PR is merged? I can run a quick sweep for clarity. maya-design: Thanks everyone 44d I'll push updates by EOD and tag this thread for review.
